fix_plan: In ExplorationScene.create() NPC render loop (around line 930), after constructing nameLabel with setOrigin(0.5, 0), measure nameLabel.width and clamp the label's x position so its left/right edges stay within [labelPad, roomPxWidth - labelPad] using Phaser.Math.Clamp. roomPxWidth = room.width * TILE. Origin/tween/completed-alpha behavior preserved; only the x coordinate is adjusted post-construction.
diff_summary: Added 9-line clamp block after nameLabel construction in NPC render loop: measures nameLabel.width and clamps x to keep label inside roomPxWidth - padding on both edges.
notes: Clamp is symmetric (handles both left and right overflow). Guard `if (maxX >= minX)` skips the clamp if the label is wider than the room itself (degenerate case) so we don't pin it off-canvas.
